Specification: This module is a dummy replacement for the standard Naturals module. Its comments explain that the operators are placeholders expected to be overridden by tools such as TLC, and that the real semantics are provided elsewhere. The file defines arithmetic, comparison, and range operators with trivial bodies so that tools can recognize and replace them; it does not model a transition system, uses no variables, and states no temporal properties.
